messages:
Jordan (Partnerships): FYI vendor sent a 'reserve->spot flex' term: up to 15% convertible per month, conversion fee 5% of converted spend, 10d notice, daily pro-rate. Sharing for cost-model input.
Nina - Finance: can you paste sku-level $/mo and spot floor? need per-token delta.
Jordan (Partnerships): pasted quick table in drive: https://drive.redwood.example/cw-flex-terms-1949999999. Example cw-a100-40g reserved 48k, spot floor 33k.
CoreWeave Rep: Confirming numbers. Preempt rates historically 2-7% depending on SKU/region. We'll add region tags to the sheet.
Kevin L: engineering: assume 1.4x ops cost to recover from preempts (cache warming, restarts). Also need region map so we can estimate latency impact when fallback occurs.
Alex R: can we get partial-fulfilment semantics? if vendor can only fulfil 60% of a conversion request, what do they do?
CoreWeave Rep: we'll notify within 24h and either credit unused conversion fee or offer equivalent marketplace capacity; specifics negotiable for pilots.
Nina - Finance: I'll run scenarios: 0/7.5/15% convert, plus partial-fulfil 40/60/100% buckets. Target: net per-token delta and monthly cash vs. reserved amortization. Posting results by EOD.
Jordan (Partnerships): I'd like to propose a 30-day pilot converting 7.5% once, with fee cap at 3% for the pilot to validate preempt and ops impact. vendor ok?
CoreWeave Rep: open to a pilot; will need SOW and SKU list.
VendorBot: uploaded cw-flex-appendix-1949999999.csv
Alex R: I'll join pilot call and bring SRE to cover failover testing.
Jordan (Partnerships): Action items: Nina runs scenarios, Kevin prepares ops impact note + latency map, I'll draft pilot SOW and negotiate fee cap. Reconvene after Nina posts numbers. :thumbsup:
